title: Welding & Fabrication

canonicalTerminology.definition: A welding procedure defines controlled variables and instructions for producing a weld under an applicable quality and qualification framework.

claims.text: Railway fabrication quality depends on controlled preparation, welding processes, personnel competence, inspection, documentation and applicable product-specific requirements.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.
